_comment: slug -> directive mapping. Each webhook maps to exactly ONE directive with scoped tool access. Tools must be keys of TOOLS in execution/run_directive.py: drive_search, drive_read (connector-backed, no credentials file) or send_email, read_sheet, update_sheet (Python, need Google OAuth token.json). The grant is passed to the CLI as --allowedTools, so it is enforced.

daily_digest.description: Summarize the tracking sheet and leave the digest as a Gmail draft (never sends).

drive_inventory.description: Read-only inventory of Google Sheets in Drive, via the claude.ai Drive connector.

content_week.description: Review the week's content plan, flag 48h risk, draft next week's sheet. Drafts email, never sends.
